أفضل وقتها الآن: من الفجر إلى طلوع الشمس: Isikhathi sayo esihle manje: kusukela ekuseni kuze kuphume ilanga.
Isikhathi sakho manje; okungcono kakhulu ngemva kokuntwela kokusa.
يمتد وقتها عند بعض العلماء إلى العصر، فإ: Ezinye izazi zelula isikhathi saso kuze kufike ku-Asr; uma uphuthelwe, yisho manje.
أفضل وقتها الآن: من العصر إلى غروب الشمس: Isikhathi sayo esihle manje: kusukela e-Asr kuze kube sekushoneni kwelanga.
وقتها الآن، ويمتد عند كثير من العلماء إل: Isikhathi sakho manje; izazi eziningi zinweba kuze kube sekuseni.
يمتد وقتها عند كثير من العلماء في الليل،: Izazi eziningi zelula isikhathi saso kuze kube sebusuku; inkumbulo yasekuseni iqala ngovivi.
قال الله تعالى: ﴿فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِي: UAllah uthi: “Ngakho-ke dumisani uAllah lapho nifika kusihlwa nalapho nifika ekuseni” (al-Rum 30:17), futhi: “Dumisa udumo lweNkosi yakho ngaphambi kokuphuma kwelanga nangaphambi kokushona kwalo” (Qaf 50:39).
تظهر أذكار الصباح من الفجر حتى العصر، وأ: Izikhumbuzo zasekuseni zibonisa kusukela ngo-Fajr kuze kufike ku-Asr nezinkumbulo zakusihlwa kusukela ku-Asr kuze kube nguFajr, ezibalwa kusukela ezikhathini zomkhuleko zedolobha lakho, futhi zisebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi. Isikhathi esihle sasekuseni siphakathi kuka-Fajr nokuphuma kwelanga nesikhathi sakusihlwa esingcono kakhulu phakathi kwe-Asr nokushona kwelanga, futhi ungakwazi ukuvula enye isethi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi.
النصوص من كتاب «حصن المسلم من أذكار الكت: Imibhalo iphuma ku-Hisn al-Muslim kaDkt Said ibn Ali ibn Wahf al-Qahtani, kanye namavesi e-Quranic avela ku-Mushaf (Hafs) ehlanganisiwe. Isikhumbuzo ngasinye sibonisa umthombo waso kanye nokugreda ngokwethembeka; lapho osolwazi be-hadith behluka ngobuqiniso kubhalwe ukuthi “Izinga eliphikisanayo”.
رفيقك اليومي: حفظ بخطة مراجعة، وأذكار ال: Umngane wakho wansuku zonke: ukubamba ngekhanda ngohlelo lokubuyekeza, izikhumbuzo zasekuseni nakusihlwa, nezikhathi zomkhuleko.
تظهر في وقتها حسب مدينتك، بنصوص حصن المس: Kuboniswa ngesikhathi esifanele sedolobha lakho, nemibhalo ye-Hisn al-Muslim nemithombo yayo, kanye nekhawunta yalowo nalowo.
§a.kursi.m: Ngiphephela kuAllah kuSathane oxoshiwe. Bese kuba yi-Ayat al-Kursi (al-Baqarah 2:255).
§a.kursi.v: Noma ubani oyifunda ekuseni uvikelekile emajini kuze kube kusihlwa, futhi oyifundayo kusihlwa uvikelekile kubo kuze kuse.
§a.kursi.s: Al-Hakim (1/562); Ibhalwe ukuthi iyiqiniso ngu-al-Albani e-Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273)
§a.baqara.v: Noma ngubani ofunde amavesi amabili okugcina e-Surat al-Baqarah ebusuku, azomnela.
§a.quls.m: I-Surat al-Ikhlas, i-Surat al-Falaq ne-Surat al-Nas, ngayinye iqala nge-Basmala.
§a.quls.v: Noma ubani ozowafunda kathathu ekuseni nakusihlwa uyobe amnele kukho konke.
§a.quls.s: U-Abu Dawud (5082) kanye no-al-Tirmidhi (3575); bheka iSahih al-Tirmidhi (3/182)
§a.mulk.m: Singene ekuseni, futhi bonke ubukhosi bungekaAllah. Udumo malube kuAllah. Akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaAllah yedwa, ongenamlingani; Ubukhosi bungobaKhe futhi udumo lungolwaKhe, futhi Unamandla phezu kwezinto zonke. Nkosi yami, ngicela kuwe okuhle kwalolu suku nobuhle balokho olulandela, futhi ngiphephela Kuwe ebubini balolu suku nasebubini bolulandela. Nkosi yami, ngiphephela Kuwe ebuvilapheni nasosizini lokuguga. Nkosi yami, ngiphephela Kuwe ekujezisweni koMlilo nasekujezisweni ethuneni.
§a.mulk.e: Singene kusihlwa, futhi bonke ubukhosi bungekaAllah. Udumo malube kuAllah. Akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaAllah yedwa, ongenamlingani; Ubukhosi bungobaKhe futhi udumo lungolwaKhe, futhi Unamandla phezu kwezinto zonke. Nkosi yami ngicela ubuhle balobu busuku kanye nobuhle balokho obulandelayo, futhi ngiphephela Kuwe ebubini balobu busuku kanye nobubi bobulandelayo. Nkosi yami, ngiphephela Kuwe ebuvilapheni nasosizini lokuguga. Nkosi yami, ngiphephela Kuwe ekujezisweni koMlilo nasekujezisweni ethuneni.
§a.mulk.v: UMprofethi ﷺ wayekusho njalo ekuseni nakusihlwa.
§a.bika.m: O Allah, Ngawe singena ekuseni futhi Ngawe singena kusihlwa, Ngawe siyaphila futhi ngawe siyafa, futhi kuWe ukuvuka.
§a.bika.e: O Allah, Ngawe singena kusihlwa futhi Ngawe singena ekuseni, Ngawe siyaphila futhi Ngawe siyafa, futhi kuWe isiphetho.
§a.bika.s: U-Al-Tirmidhi (3391) no-Abu Dawud (5068); bheka iSahih al-Tirmidhi (3/142)
§a.sayyid.m: O Allah, Wena uyiNkosi yami; akukho Nkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho. Ungidalile futhi ngiyinceku yaKho, futhi ngigcina isivumelwano Sakho nesithembiso ngokusemandleni ami. Ngiphephela Kuwe ebubini balokho engikwenzile. Ngiyavuma umusa Wakho phezu kwami ​​futhi ngiyasivuma isono sami, ngakho ngithethelele, ngokuba akekho othethelela izono ngaphandle Kwakho.
§a.sayyid.v: Inkosi yokunxusa intethelelo: noma ubani osho ngokuqiniseka kusihlwa futhi wafa ngalobo busuku ungena ePharadesi, kanjalo nasekuseni.
§a.ushhid.m: O Allah, ngingene ekuseni ngibiza Wena ukuba ube ngufakazi, futhi ngibiza abaphethe iSihlalo Sakho sobukhosi, nezingelosi Zakho kanye nayo yonke indalo Yakho ukuba babe ngofakazi, ukuthi Wena unguAllah, akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho Wedwa ongenamlingani, nokuthi uMuhammad uyinceku nesiThunywa saKho.
§a.ushhid.e: O Allah, ngingene kusihlwa ngibiza Wena ukuba ube ngofakazi, futhi ngibiza abaphethe iSihlalo Sakho, izingelosi Zakho kanye nayo yonke indalo Yakho ukuba babe ngofakazi, ukuthi Wena unguAllah, akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kwaWe wedwa ongenamlingani, nokuthi uMuhammad uyinceku yaKho nesiThunywa.
§a.ushhid.v: Noma ubani osho izikhathi ezine, uAllah Uyamkhulula emlilweni.
§a.ushhid.s: Abu Dawud (5069); U-Ibn Baz ubeke kahle iketango lakhe e-Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.nima.m: O Allah, noma yisiphi isibusiso enginaso noma esinye sezidalwa zaKho ekuseni sivela kuWe wedwa, ngaphandle komlingani. KuWe udumo futhi kukuWe ukubonga.
§a.nima.e: O Allah, noma yisiphi isibusiso enginaso noma esinye sezidalwa zaKho kulobu busuku sivela kuWe wedwa, ngaphandle komlingani. KuWe udumo futhi kukuWe ukubonga.
§a.nima.v: Osho ekuseni ubonge ngosuku lwakhe, nosho kusihlwa ubonge ngobusuku bakhe.
§a.nima.s: Abu Dawud (5073); U-Ibn Baz ubeke kahle iketango lakhe e-Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.afini.m: O Allah, ngiphe ukuphila kahle emzimbeni wami. O Allah, ngiphe ukuthula ezindlebeni zami. O Allah, ngiphe ukuthula emehlweni ami. Akukho Nkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho. O Allah, ngiphephela Kuwe ekungakholwani nasebumpofu, futhi ngiphephela Kuwe ekujezisweni kwethuna. Akukho Nkulunkulu ngaphandle kwakho.
§a.afini.v: UmProfethi ﷺ wayevamise ukunxusa ngayo kathathu njalo ekuseni nakusihlwa.
§a.afini.s: Abu Dawud (5090) kanye Ahmad (5/42); U-Ibn Baz ubeke kahle iketango lakhe e-Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.hasbi.m: UAllah unganele; akukho Nkulunkulu ngaphandle kwaKhe. KuYe ngibeka ithemba lami, futhi UyiNkosi yesihlalo sobukhosi esinamandla.
§a.hasbi.v: Noma ubani akusho kasikhombisa ekuseni nakusihlwa, uAllah Uyomanelisa kukho konke okumkhathazayo emhlabeni kanye nakwelizayo.
§a.hasbi.s: U-Abu Dawud (5081) njengesitatimende sika-Abu al-Darda; U-Shuayb no-Abd al-Qadir al-Arnaut balinganise uchungechunge lwayo njengoluyiqiniso oshicilweni lwabo lwe-Zad al-Maad (2/376)
§a.hasbi.n: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi isitatimende esingumngane, futhi amazwi aso akuQuran (al-Tawbah 9:129).
§a.afw.m: O Allah, ngicela intethelelo kanye nenhlalakahle kulo mhlaba kanye nakwelizayo. O Allah, ngicela intethelelo kanye nenhlalakahle enkolweni yami, ezindabeni zami zomhlaba, emndenini wami kanye nasengcebweni yami. O Allah, vala amaphutha ami futhi wehlise ukwesaba kwami. O Allah, ngivikele phambi kwami ​​nangemuva kwami, kwesokudla sami nakwesobunxele sami, nangaphezulu kwami, futhi ngiphephela ebukhulu Bakho ekuthathweni ngingalindele ngaphansi kwami.
§a.afw.v: UMprofethi ﷺ akazange ashiye lezi zicelo kusihlwa nasekuseni.
§a.afw.s: U-Abu Dawud (5074) kanye no-Ibn Majah (3871); Ibhalwe ukuthi iyiqiniso ngu-al-Albani eSahih Ibn Majah (2/332)
§a.alim.m: O Allah, uMazi wokungabonakali nokubonwayo, Mdali wezulu nomhlaba, Nkosi kanye noMbusi wezinto zonke, ngiyafakaza ukuthi akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle Kwakho. Ngiphephela Kuwe ebubini bomphefumulo wami nasebubini bukaSathane kanye nobizo lwakhe lokuhlanganyela Nawe, nasekuziletheleni ububi phezu kwami ​​noma phezu kwanoma yimuphi umSulumane.
§a.alim.v: UmProfethi ﷺ wafundisa u-Abu Bakr ukuthi athi ekuseni, kusihlwa kanye nalapho eyolala.
§a.alim.s: U-Al-Tirmidhi (3392) no-Abu Dawud (5067); bheka iSahih al-Tirmidhi (3/142)
§a.bismillah.m: Egameni likaAllah, ogama lakhe akukho okungadala umonakalo emhlabeni noma ezulwini, futhi Uyizwa Konke, Wazi Konke.
§a.bismillah.v: Okusho kathathu ekuseni nakusihlwa kathathu, akukho lutho oluyomlimaza.
§a.bismillah.s: Abu Dawud (5088), al-Tirmidhi (3388) kanye Ibn Majah (3869); U-Ibn Baz ubeke kahle iketango lakhe e-Tuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.radit.m: Ngithokozile ngoAllah njengeNkosi yami, nge-Islam njengenkolo yami, noMuhammad ﷺ njengoMprofethi wami.
§a.radit.v: Noma ubani okusho kathathu ekuseni nakusihlwa, uAllah Uthembise ukumthokozisa ngoSuku Lokuvuka.
§a.radit.s: Abu Dawud (5072), al-Tirmidhi (3389) kanye Ahmad (4/337); ihlelwe kahle ngu-Ibn Baz eTuhfat al-Akhyar
§a.radit.n: Amagama ngokwawo ayiqiniso kuSahih Muslim (386), ashiwo lapho ezwa ubizo lomthandazo.
§a.hayy.m: O Ophilayo, O Msekeli wakho konke, ngomusa Wakho ngifuna usizo. Lungisa zonke izindaba zami, ungangishiyi ngedwa ngisho ngokuphazima kweso.
§a.hayy.v: UmProfethi ﷺ weluleka uFatimah ukuthi akusho njalo ekuseni nakusihlwa.
§a.hayy.s: U-Al-Hakim (1/545), owathi iyiqiniso ngokuvuma kuka-al-Dhahabi; ubekwe kahle ngu-al-Albani e-Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273)
§a.fath.m: Sesingenile ekuseni, futhi bonke ubukhosi bungekaAllah, iNkosi yemihlaba. O Allah, ngicela kuwe okuhle kwalolu suku: ukunqoba kwalo, usizo lwalo, ukukhanya kwalo, isibusiso salo kanye nokuholwa kwalo, futhi ngiphephela Kuwe ebubini obukulo kanye nobubi obungemva kwalo.
§a.fath.e: Sesingenile kusihlwa, futhi bonke ubukhosi bungekaAllah, iNkosi yemihlaba. O Allah, ngicela okuhle Kuwe ngalobu busuku: ukunqoba kwabo, usizo lwabo, ukukhanya kwabo, isibusiso sabo kanye nokuholwa kwabo, futhi ngiphephela Kuwe ebubini obukubo nasebubini obungemva kwabo.
§a.fath.s: Abu Dawud (5084); U-Shuayb no-Abd al-Qadir al-Arnaut bafake iketango elihle ohlelweni lwabo lwe-Zad al-Maad (2/273)
§a.fitra.m: Singene ekuseni ngendlela yemvelo yamaSulumane, ngezwi lokukholwa okuqotho, phezu kwenkolo yoMprofethi wethu uMuhammad, nasendleleni kababa wethu u-Ibrahim, eqotho futhi ethobekile, futhi wayengeyena omunye walabo abahlanganisa noAllah.
§a.fitra.e: Singene kusihlwa ngendlela yemvelo ye-Islam, ngezwi lokukholwa okuqotho, phezu kwenkolo yoMprofethi wethu uMuhammad, nasendleleni kababa wethu u-Ibrahim, eqotho futhi ethobekile, futhi wayengeyena omunye walabo abahlanganisa noAllah.
§a.fitra.s: U-Ahmad (3/406–407) kanye no-Ibn al-Sunni ku-Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (34); bheka iSahih al-Jami (4/209)
§a.subhan.m: Udumo malube kuAllah, futhi udumo malube kuYe.
§a.subhan.v: Noma ubani osho izikhathi eziyikhulu ekuseni nakusihlwa, akekho ozoletha okungcono ngoSuku Lokuvuka kwabafileyo ngaphandle kwalowo osho okufanayo noma ngaphezulu.
§a.tahlil10.m: Akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaAllah yedwa, ongenamlingani. Ubukhosi bungobaKhe futhi udumo lungolwaKhe, futhi Unamandla phezu kwezinto zonke.
§a.tahlil10.v: Izikhathi eziyishumi, noma kanye lapho ukhathele; osho izikhathi eziyishumi ufana nokhulule imiphefumulo emine enzalweni ka-Ismail.
§a.tahlil10.s: Sahih Muslim (2693); bheka iSahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/272)
§a.tahlil100.m: Akekho unkulunkulu ngaphandle kukaAllah yedwa, ongenamlingani. Ubukhosi bungobaKhe futhi udumo lungolwaKhe, futhi Unamandla phezu kwezinto zonke.
§a.tahlil100.v: Izikhathi eziyikhulu ekuseni: kufana nokukhulula izigqila eziyishumi, ikhulu lezenzo ezinhle zibhalelwe yena, izono eziyikhulu ziyasulwa, futhi kumvikela kuSathane ngalolo suku kuze kube kusihlwa.
§a.adad.m: Udumo malube kuAllah futhi udumo malube Kuye, izikhathi eziningi ngokwenani lendalo yaKhe, ngokumthokozisayo, esinda njengesihlalo saKhe sobukhosi, kanye noyinki wamazwi Akhe.
§a.adad.v: UMprofethi (ukuthula makube kuye) wabatshela uJuwayriyah ngemva komthandazo wokuntwela kokusa, futhi wathi bazokwedlula konke ayekushilo kusukela ekuseni.
§a.ilm.m: O Allah, ngicela ulwazi oluzuzisayo, ukuhlinzeka okuhle kanye nezenzo ezamukelekayo.
§a.ilm.v: UmProfethi ﷺ wayesho njalo emva kokuqeda umthandazo wokuntwela kokusa.
§a.ilm.s: Ibn Majah (925) kanye Ibn al-Sunni (54); ibhalwe ukuthi iyiqiniso ngu-al-Albani eSahih Ibn Majah
§a.istighfar.m: Ngicela intethelelo kuAllah futhi ngiphendukele kuYe ngokuphenduka.
§a.istighfar.v: UmProfethi ﷺ wayehlala ecela intethelelo kuAllah futhi ephenduka kuYe izikhathi eziyikhulu ngosuku.
§a.kalimat.m: Ngiphephela emazwini aphelele kaAllah ebubini balokho Akudalile.
§a.kalimat.v: Noma ubani okusho kusihlwa ngeke alinyazwe yinoma yikuphi udosi ngalobo busuku.
§a.kalimat.s: U-Sahih Muslim (2709), u-Ahmad (2/290) kanye no-al-Nasai ku-Amal al-Yawm wa al-Laylah (590)
§a.salat.m: O Allah, thumela izibusiso nokuthula kuMprofethi wethu uMuhammad.
§a.salat.v: Noma ubani othumela izibusiso kimi izikhathi eziyishumi ekuseni nangeshumi kusihlwa uyothola ukuncenga kwami ​​ngoSuku Lokuvuka.
§a.salat.s: Al-Tabarani; bheka i-Majma al-Zawaid (10/120) kanye ne-Sahih al-Targhib wa al-Tarhib (1/273)
§a.salat.n: Iketanga layo liyaphikiswa; Ubuhle bokuthumela izibusiso kuMprofethi ﷺ buyiqiniso kuSahih Muslim (408).
